title: Fix Sketchpad Scope Provider Runtime Error
description: Fix compose/sketchpad runtime failure where SketchpadScopeProvider references getDefaultSketchpadScopeId but the helper is not defined. Patch the sketchpad source, extend the existing sketchpad test coverage for the scope-id fallback behavior, and verify the affected build/tests.
summary: Restored a deterministic default sketchpad scope id so standalone sketchpad boots without the missing helper crash, fixed the provider hook-order violation by keeping hook execution unconditional after hydration, and added an existing-file regression test covering fallback scope-id boot and reload stability.
